extraction.Name: Helena Swallow
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee but that she took it because the Farmer and Agency Office told her that she must take it and pay the taxes of lose the land so she took it and signed the receipt
extraction.Buyer: sold 160 acres of her land to pay the taxes on the allotment for $700.00 and that later she sold the other 160.00 to pay the taxes on her husbands land, receiving $700.00 for the second quarter
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: sold 160 acres of her land to pay the taxes on the allotment for $700.00 and that later she sold the other 160.00 to pay the taxes on her husbands land
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in poor health, suffering with rhumatism; has no land, no home and nothing; has seven children; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since her patent was granted to her; affidavit sworn November 28, 1928
